timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Tell us a little bit about yourself and where are we right now?
I have been a mastering engineer for 25 years.
I'm the chief mastering engineer here at Lackrich Channel Mastering.
Lackrich Channel has been a studio for almost 50 years.
In fact, in 2025, we celebrated in the University of New York.
What do you do use for a mastering?
I use magic sequoia and I've actually been using it since the start of my career.
They just recently released 2017 and it's dramatically changed my mastering.
What's so great about this new version?
First of all, they've kept up with the transparency.
They've always been really great with it.
It doesn't change the sound of flying clusters.
But there's a couple new features which I really like when it's
comping the other's multiple file export, the stack support.
And the last one is external effects as a plus.
